reviews.comment: Great course and a great prof! You get to use industry products with the MPs, and there is lots of opportunities for extra credit. The textbook is provided by him, but I didn't really use it. His slides are really good, and so are his lectures. The MPs are challenging, but rewarding. I would definitely recommend this course and prof.

Great class, 100% would recommend taking. It is a little difficult but the MPs are well done and provide a great background. The only thing that sucks is the quizzes. They're a little misleading/badly worded. The topics and content are super worth it to learn and done in a good setting.

Quizzes have poor wording: what he believes should be the right answer to a question doesn't really make sense to anyone else. They also cover content that is not covered in lecture or slides (textbook reading required), so attending lecture is essentially useless. He's not someone who patiently works with students who struggle with a new concept.

Lectures are boring but he gives bonus points if you answer questions in class. HWs are on canvas but sometimes the answers are incorrect (have to argue with him to fix it). Midterm was just HW questions and stuff discussed in lecture. Machine problems are pretty difficult but doable if you start early. Overall, this class was set up poorly.

The hardest class I've taken at A&M so far got my first B in this class. Programming assignments and quizzes are very difficult so prepare to start early. Great lecturer and a very chill and understanding guy. The content is very interesting. Could do better to prepare students for exams.

VERY difficult class, but his lectures help a lot. Generous with quiz points; the quizzes are very tough. The programming projects are VERY complex and you will need to brush up on CSCE 313 concepts such as sockets and system calls. He allows one assignment and one quiz late, 4 days and 1 day respectively.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is the best professor plus the best advisor. If you want to conduct research on wireless, distributed systems, and become a good researcher, directly ask for his help. His analytical power to pinpoint a problem and conduct systematic research on it is phenomenal. I took three classes with him and they were the best, still counting to take more.

Had him for wireless and he's been great. Lectures are intuitive to understand and homework problems aren't that bad. Class average wasn't that great for midterm but I did well since his homework helps. Helpful outside of class too.
Distributed Processing System The class was super interesting. Prof is helping and has a cheerful attitude. Exams are critical for scoring a good grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is a very decent teacher. He helped me debug my own code for hours and didnt show irritation. His lectures are clear and they make sense, unlike millions of folks teaching out there. Outside of class, he is there to help you if needed. The class itself requires work but having a great teacher saves lots of pain. I recommend him for any class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures
